name: La Paz (Cesar, Colombia)
description: Horizontal bicolour of green and red, charged at the centre with the white outline map of the municipality and a row of six red five-pointed stars on a white stripe along the top.
history: Municipal flag of Los Robles La Paz, a municipality in the department of Cesar, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: thin white stripe along the top
six stars along the top stripe
